newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan auctions six-month bonds in OMO.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan auctions six-month bonds in OMO.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said it auctioned six-month maturity short-term federal bonds worth 400 million rupees ($11.2 million) in an open market operation (OMO) on Wednesday.
It said bids worth 400 million rupees were accepted for the bond five-month repurchase contract (repo) at a maximum cut-off of 16.50 percent.

In the previous OMO on January 15, bids worth 25 million rupees were accepted for the outright sale of the six-month bonds at a maximum cut-off of 16.50 percent per annum while bids worth 100 million rupees were accepted for five month repo at 16.50 percent.
